notes.title: Dev report #5 ~ March update
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/FND9nKEz9q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/651105de3d95ab6f83b2ce872928677b691bea30.png[/img][/url]

Hello Explorers!

March has been packed with new content and some major improvements across the board.  
From visual upgrades to brand new gameplay systems, we’ve been focused on deepening the player experience and making each run through Chaos Islands feel more exciting.

Let’s take a look at everything that was added last month!

[h2]Boss Buffs[/h2]

To make boss fights more dynamic and challenging, we added a set of  
[b]new randomized buffs[/b] that can appear on bosses during encounters:

[list]
[*][b]Berserker[/b] – Deals more damage when low on health.[/*]
[*][b]Regenerator[/b] – Restores health points at the start of each turn.[/*]
[*][b]Aggressor[/b] – Attacks deal 1.5× damage.[/*]
[*][b]Beefy[/b] – Takes 25% reduced damage.[/*]
[*][b]Hellborn[/b] – Resistant to fire damage.[/*]
[*][b]Thick Skin[/b] – Max HP increased by 50%.[/*]  
[/list]

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

We introduced [b]several new enemy types[/b] last month, expanding the range of challenges players will face:

[h3]Infested + zulk[/h3]  
Infested demon carries a parasite, zulk, that will be spawned after the host's death unless the player uses special cards or defensive constructions to prevent that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/1d682264633eedaaa07615dd5ae4a566c87c2d19.png[/img]

We also had a funny bug during the development of that enemy – accidentally we created a very powerful boss.

[previewyoutube=MarWOjiW5iM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Summoner[/h3]  
A dangerous and beefy enemy that can summon reinforcements if the player does not deal with him quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/c259eef002cf16dd6ebda20c7993c4cdf3b5e477.png[/img]

[h3]Necromancer[/h3]  
Their job is to bring the dead back to life using [b]pile of bones[/b] – and create chaos on the battlefield.

When enemies die, they now leave behind a [b]Pile of Bones[/b].  
If necromancer units are present (or arrive later), they can use these piles to  
[b]resurrect fallen enemies[/b].

In some battles, bone piles may even be placed on the field before combat starts.  
So players will have to take care of them before the battle to avoid a bigger threat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/baf3d5a77540569edafd1448956be281b1cd5617.png[/img]

[h2]Node Map Updates[/h2]

We continued developing the node map by adding new mechanics as well as slowly improving visual style.

[h3]What's New:[/h3]
[list]  
[*][b]Playable Nodes[/b] - These are nodes that launch an actual game session, requiring players to complete an in-game challenge to proceed.[/*]
[*][b]Event Nodes[/b] were implemented. These offer narrative-style choices - some helpful, some... not so much.[/*]
[*][b]Locks & Keys[/b] Some paths will be locked and require keys to unlock - so players will have to do some exploration in order to find a key or another path.[/*]  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/4c7492ac7eff496280b7984208530ed4797f4226.png[/img]

[h2]New Environment: Lake Tile[/h2]

To break up the chaos with some serenity, we added a [b]Lake[/b] tile type.  
Expect to find this peaceful feature on some islands during your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/9499369d3515c8d111a6c35d583e0efa48e4f996.png[/img]

And that’s all for this month! We’ll continue expanding enemy types, balancing the new gameplay systems, and preparing more progression surprises in the coming month!

➡️ We encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FND9nKEz9q]Discord[/url].  
We are posting updates each week and we would like to chat with you :)

[b]Until next time![/b]

notes.title: Dev report #4 ~ February update
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/p8rmcv2dJk]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/651105de3d95ab6f83b2ce872928677b691bea30.png[/img]
[/url]

Hello everyone!

Welcome to this month’s Chaos Islands Dev Report! Over the past few weeks, we’ve been hard at work improving the game, refining its systems, and introducing new content. Here’s what we’ve been up to!

[h2]Progression System Updates[/h2]

Progression is a core aspect of Chaos Islands, and we’ve made significant strides in developing its mechanics.

[list]
[*] The [b]node generation algorithm[/b] is now complete! This was a crucial step in designing the game’s progression system, allowing us to create a dynamic and engaging experience for players.
[*] With the algorithm in place, we’ve started working on [b]player movement mechanics[/b], different [b]node types[/b], and [b]interaction mechanics[/b] to bring the system to life and showcase them on incoming playtests.
[*] Additionally, we are constantly working on improving the visuals, ensuring they fit seamlessly into the evolving gameplay experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/b3289ea8c06e945e8fb3d5f72f567761bff7eac8.png[/img]

[h2]Enhancing UX and UI[/h2]

Improving player experience is always a priority, and we’ve made a few key adjustments:

[list]
[*] [b]Card Descriptions[/b] - We’ve enhanced card descriptions by adding [b]icons and refining the design[/b] to make their effects clearer.
[*] [b]Season UI[/b] - While season effects were already present in the buffs section, playtesters often overlooked them. To address this, we’ve introduced a [b]new UI element[/b] near the season clock, ensuring players can easily see the current season’s impact.
[*] We’ve also fixed several [b]bugs[/b] discovered during recent playtests, leading to a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/2683ac12efa3599f4a7e160304e2d98e0d410305.png[/img]

[h2]New Enemies Enter the Fray![/h2]

Combat is getting more intense with the addition of several new enemy types, each bringing unique mechanics to challenge players:

[list]
[*] [b]Shaman[/b] – Places demonic wards around the map to boost other demons.
[*] [b]Infested[/b] – Spawns an [b]Imp[/b] upon death.
[*] [b]Imp[/b] – A smaller, more agile version of the [b]Minion demon[/b].
[*] [b]Summoner[/b] – Continuously spawns [b]Imps[/b] around itself.
[*] [b]Lich[/b] – Has the ability to [b]revive fallen demons[/b], making battles even more unpredictable.
[*] [b]Bomber[/b] – Explodes upon death, dealing [b]damage to surrounding tiles[/b].
[/list]

We are also working on additional demon types, which we hope to reveal in the near future!

[h2]New Defense Constructions[/h2]

To counter these new threats, we’ve introduced powerful defensive structures to aid players in battle:

[list]
[*] [b]Ice Tower[/b] – Freezes enemies for a few turns.
[*] [b]Fire Tower[/b] – Sets enemies and surrounding tiles on fire.
[/list]

These defenses come with a fun interaction mechanic: [b]fire cancels ice and vice versa[/b]. Additionally, the [b]Fire Tower won’t be as effective during rain or snowstorms[/b], adding another layer of strategy to the game!

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

As development continues, we’re focused on refining progression, introducing more engaging enemies, and improving gameplay balance. We can’t wait to share more with you in our next updates!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback—it truly helps us shape Chaos Islands into the best game it can be.

notes.title: Dev report #0 ~ The state of the game
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to our first development report!

We’re a small team of game developers based in Warsaw who love creating unique and engaging experiences. This game started as a simple idea, and with your support, it’s growing into something we’re proud of.

Starting today, we’ll be posting updates here on our Steam page. In each report, we’ll share our progress, show new features, and let you know about upcoming changes.

Thank you for joining us on this journey and let's jump into what we currently have!

[h1]Building[/h1]
Building mechanic is the core of our game. Also, this part is closely connected with other parts of the game - the way you build your settlement impacts different events that occur during the game session, dialogues and the behavior of the enemies during the siege wave.

It is important to keep building mechanics simple to understand but meaningful when it comes to building your settlements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/3858219001cdb92949e76e55d440967b1a24a5db.png[/img]

Buildings come in many types, each serving a distinct purpose. Some generate or collect resources, others act as defenses by attacking enemies (like catapults or ballistas), and some provide valuable buffs. There are also explosive traps that detonate when destroyed, perfect for setting up ambushes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/24eef76e97e721a4d4400e1f9bdcdac71ef249a7.png[/img]

[h1]Cards[/h1]
One of the main features of our game after building. Currently, we have 23 cards in the game that we are actively adding. Amount of cards and their diversity are important as they represent your actions inside the game and play a key role in your strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/06bfce6e06390dfea0e6c6b73da2189df1f943ba.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/11f63320749fb617e8212307a9a872ca7d15b755.png[/img]

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
Enemies are the demon forces that are attracted to your settlement as soon as you reach enough chaos. Currently, we have 3 enemies that have different behavior, attack patterns and stats. And obviously we are working on adding more of them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/605912841381a3421a9e32629a6014e56eed4c9b.gif[/img]

[h1]Seasons and weather[/h1]
During the game, you will face different seasons and weather conditions. They impact the properties of the settlement and may trigger some events, and dialogues or give buffs. The appearance of your settlement will be changed as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/7ddaf2bcefeb4c99b22e8814ce891c58715839f4.png[/img]

[h1]Resource balancing[/h1]
We decided to approach resource management uniquely. Along with gathering resources, you’ll also need to keep them balanced. Maintaining a good balance brings rewards, while poor balance can lead to some tough consequences…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/420c13f5dfff3de3fa950b2c93673654aea10d1b.png[/img]

[h1]Dialogs[/h1]
Dialogues are events that you will face during the session. Some of them provide tough choices and will impact the life of your settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/61b7165a0d8b4c18071adcfbe43ddfca2ec47e7c.png[/img]

[h1]Quests[/h1]
Some of these will be accepted throughout the session to gain essential resources, cards, buffs, or currency, as well as to advance the game's story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/1caafa0ee80e8adf138b2606eb7be00e42bf8df6.png[/img]

[h1]Settlement level[/h1]
By building the settlement correctly and making the right choices, you will increase the settlement level, which will unlock cards with special abilities that can significantly improve your strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/25e7e064984fefa6b952804bcff64d22cd855bda.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44967334/2efbf86793c7c9bc437701530ad3519d9ee9e88c.png[/img]

Join us on Discord—we'd love to hear from you! Stay tuned for upcoming updates!
